subject: Initial discovery + kickoff: coordinating stakeholders and evidence requests
messages:
From: Liam Patel <liam.patel@axiomcommerce.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@axiomcommerce.com>, procure@axiomcommerce.com, security@axiomcommerce.com
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -0400
Subject: Kickoff request — initial discovery + stakeholders

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the intro, team. We (Axiom Commerce) are keen to run a short discovery to understand Redwood's hosting modes and security posture. We'd like the following folks on the call: myself (product champion), Priya (engineering lead), and a procurement contact to talk SOW/PO timing. Security has flagged SOC 2 evidence as a prerequisite for the deeper technical review.

Can you propose 2–3 60-minute windows next week (US Eastern) that include an AE and an SE? Ideally Priya would join for the first 30 minutes to validate integration assumptions.

Thanks — Liam
Liam Patel, Senior Product Manager
Axiom Commerce
liam.patel@axiomcommerce.com

--
Attachment: Axiom-Intake-Notes.txt (text)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam Patel <liam.patel@axiomcommerce.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com>, procure@axiomcommerce.com, security@axiomcommerce.com
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 17:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Kickoff request — initial discovery + stakeholders

Hi Liam — great to e-meet you.

Ben (AE) and Soojin (SE) will join. For planning: 60 minutes is perfect; we can split the agenda so Priya can join for the first 30 to cover integration constraints and network/SSO, then remain joined or drop as needed.

Proposed slots (all ET):
- Tue Aug 11, 10:00–11:00 ET
- Tue Aug 11, 15:00–16:00 ET
- Wed Aug 12, 09:00–10:00 ET

If none of those work, send two alternatives and we’ll iterate. Also attaching Redwood's SOC 2 summary and a quick checklist we typically share with security teams. If security needs more, we can route detailed docs via our compliance channel after an NDA.

Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com
T: +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: Redwood-SOC2-Summary.pdf (pdf), Redwood-Security-Checklist.md (text)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam Patel <liam.patel@axiomcommerce.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@axiomcommerce.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 18:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Kickoff request — initial discovery + stakeholders

Liam — thanks for the context. A couple of logistics notes from the AE side:
- We usually run a 15-minute pre-call for internal alignment (Ben + Soojin + Evelyn) if you'd like us to tighten the agenda — happy to do it.
- Timezone check: all slots above are ET; I can pivot if Priya is earlier or later.

If helpful, here’s another slot Thu Aug 13, 11:00–12:00 ET.

Agenda (draft):
1) 5m intros and outcomes
2) 25m product fit + infra assumptions (Priya attends)
3) 20m security/compliance Q&A (security contact joins)
4) 10m procurement next steps / timelines

I’ll send a calendar hold once we confirm.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood-inference.com
From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@axiomcommerce.com>
To: Liam Patel <liam.patel@axiomcommerce.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: procure@axiomcommerce.com, security@axiomcommerce.com
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 08:09:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Kickoff request — initial discovery + stakeholders

Thanks, all. Tue Aug 11 10:00 ET works for me. Priya here — quick asks so I can prep:
- Can Redwood share a short network diagram and the default ports/endpoints we’ll need to allow?
- We usually prefer the SE to have a test account or demo tenant to walk through integration patterns; can you confirm availability?
- Regarding SOC 2: security@axiom asked if we can get the SOC 2 summary and any pen test cadence details before the call.

If you can drop the network diagram and SOC2 summary in the thread, I’ll confirm the procurement timeline on our side.

Priya Reddy
Engineering Lead, Axiom Commerce
priya.reddy@axiomcommerce.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com>
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@axiomcommerce.com>, Liam Patel <liam.patel@axiomcommerce.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>, security@axiomcommerce.com
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Kickoff request — initial discovery + stakeholders

Priya — I’ll bring the demo tenant and a brief integration checklist. Attaching a high-level network diagram (internal-use) and the SOC 2 summary we shared earlier. For the demo tenant: I’ll provision a read-only demo API key and drop instructions in a follow-up calendar invite.

Notes attached: network-diagram-v1.drawio, Redwood-SOC2-Summary.pdf

Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@axiomcommerce.com>, Liam Patel <liam.patel@axiomcommerce.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, procure@axiomcommerce.com, security@axiomcommerce.com
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Kickoff request — initial discovery + stakeholders

Perfect — Tue Aug 11, 10:00–11:00 ET confirmed. I’ve sent a calendar invite with the conference link and attached the SOC2 summary + network diagram. Ben will run introductions and Soojin will demo. Priya — thanks for confirming.

Action items:
- Redwood: attach demo tenant details to calendar invite (Soojin)
- Axiom: procurement contact to share PO timelines after the call (procure@axiomcommerce.com)
- Security: if you need additional evidence, flag it in the calendar thread and we’ll escalate to compliance.

Looking forward — Evelyn

Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example12345
Attachments on invite: Axiom-SOC2-questions.xlsx, Redwood-SOC2-Summary.pdf, network-diagram-v1.drawio
